description: Simon Property Group, Inc. is an Indiana corporation that operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust, or REIT, under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and Simon Property Group, L.P. is its majority-owned Indiana partnership subsidiary that owns directly or indirectly all of its real estate properties and other assets, and references to Simon mean Simon Property Group, Inc. while references to the Operating Partnership mean Simon Property Group, L.P. and references to we, us and our mean collectively Simon, the Operating Partnership and those entities or subsidiaries owned or controlled by Simon and/or the Operating Partnership. The Operating Partnership also has available a global unsecured commercial paper program of $2.0 billion, or the non-U.S. dollar equivalent thereof.
